calls.title: Jake <> Brent catch up at 2:30 pm CST
calls.summary: Jake Stangl is quickly ramping up in his sales role, focusing on 150 inbound accounts with high developer engagement signals, particularly those with 500+ employees. He will conduct outbound outreach using the Apollo platform, pending Sales Navigator access. Brent Holloway emphasized the importance of balancing inbound and outbound efforts, while Jake coordinates with Ryan for lead assignments. The meeting highlighted a significant opportunity to convert 1% of 1,000 monthly open source downloads into substantial revenue, alongside challenges related to fragmented lead data across Rio and HubSpot. Tailoring outreach messaging to emphasize the value of GrowthBook's paid features is essential for converting free users. The open source base represents a significant growth opportunity, requiring systematic processes for identifying and prioritizing leads.
calls.keywords: onboarding, outbound outreach, lead prioritization, open source engagement, sales tooling, revenue operations
calls.action_items:
**Jake Stangl**
Upload high-priority Rio leads into Apollo and begin sequencing outreach as early as possible (04:30)
Follow up with Ashley during scheduled meeting to clarify inbound lead handling, reporting capabilities, and cross-tool integration between Rio and HubSpot (13:20)
Continue ramp-up by meeting the team, gaining product knowledge, and preparing to start outbound calls later in the week (23:08)
Clarify with Ryan the lead routing and round-robin processes for assigning qualified leads after discovery calls (22:40)

**Brent Holloway**
Coordinate with Ryan to finalize Jake’s onboarding plan and clarify specific go-to-market roles and responsibilities (00:13)
Assist Jake with analyzing data using Mastiff Software to identify optimal account segments for efficient sales efforts (01:30)
Work with Jake and Ryan to explore automating lead capture and qualification workflows, potentially in collaboration with new RevOps hire Jeff Ignacio (21:30)
Provide ongoing support and encourage regular check-ins to accelerate ramp-up and optimize outreach effectiveness (24:40)
